title: 21GRAMS
summary: A self-directed rebuild of the 21GRAMS agency site, created to make its light-and-dark world feel fluid, spatial, and accessible.
intro: This personal 2023 remake revisits a 21GRAMS concept I helped shape as Director of Experience, pairing its Essence-and-Craft story with smoother transitions, complete navigation, and keyboard interaction.

heroImage.alt: 21GRAMS landing experience split into light and dark fields around oversized typography and a wireframe head

role: Director of Experience (original concept) · Independent design and engineering (remake)

startingPoint.sectionHeading: The original site and the remake
startingPoint.title: The version I was responding to
startingPoint.description: The public site already established the Essence-and-Craft world, spatial structure, geometry, and agency voice. My remake preserved that foundation while revisiting how the experience moved, oriented visitors, and supported different ways of navigating.

image.alt: Archived 21GRAMS public homepage from April 2023, divided into light Essence and dark Craft fields around the agency wordmark
image.caption: Original 21GRAMS public site, implemented by an external development team and preserved here through the Internet Archive.

designSystem.name: 21GRAMS Rule of 21
designSystem.summary: A spatial editorial system built on a seven-pixel cadence, the signature Rule of 21, and two complementary visual realms.

principles.name: The Rule of 21
principles.description: Seven is the base spatial step; twenty-one is the signature unit for geometry, rhythm, and motion.

principles.name: Two realms, one system
principles.description: Craft is dark and material while Essence is light and reflective, with shared roles that invert cleanly.

principles.name: Tactile restraint
principles.description: Fine offset borders, paper tones, condensed headings, and deliberate motion create character without excess.

principles.name: Navigation is spatial
principles.description: Directional movement is part of the experience while routes remain keyboard-operable and semantically linked.

principles.name: Legibility outranks numerology
principles.description: The rule guides the work, but accessibility and content fit always have the final word.

typography.description: A compact voice for oversized statements and directional interface language.
A measured mono voice keeps navigation, labels, and supporting copy precise.
A reflective serif introduces warmth and contrast inside the geometric framework.

components.name: KeyArrow
components.description: A directional control makes spatial movement visible while retaining a conventional interaction contract.

components.name: Nav
components.description: The shared navigation maps routes to cardinal directions and remains operable by keyboard.

components.name: TextAnimated
components.description: Staged editorial copy supports cinematic pacing without withholding content when motion is reduced.

componentSnapshot.alt: 21GRAMS specimens showing crisp directional KeyArrow controls, closed and open navigation, and editorial typography in the viewer’s system theme
componentSnapshot.caption: KeyArrow, navigation, and animated type rendered from the 21GRAMS component system.

productProof.title: One system moves between two realms
productProof.description: The same seven-pixel cadence, condensed voice, and spatial navigation hold together the dark Craft experience and the light Essence experience.

image.alt: 21GRAMS in-product editorial statement rendered in the light Essence realm or dark Craft realm according to the viewer's system theme

accessibility.title: Spatial interaction keeps a semantic path
accessibility.description: Native controls, 49px targets, visible focus, semantic links, and reduced-motion behavior protect the experience; full cross-realm contrast automation remains an active gap.

internalNotes: Pete helped shape the original concept as Director of Experience, then independently designed and built this remake in 2023 with a 2024 update. It was never adopted as the agency's public site. Agency copy and original Illustrator geometry were created by other 21GRAMS team members; keep collaborator credit collective unless exact names are confirmed.
